newsitem.title: SWEDEN: Nordbanken/S-E-Banken merger not until Feb-paper.
newsitem.headline: Nordbanken/S-E-Banken merger not until Feb-paper.

text.p: A widely speculated merger between Swedish commercial bank S-E-Banken and state-controlled Nordbanken may not happen until February after the banks have posted their 1996 earnings, a newspaper said on Thursday.
"Reports in recent days about a merger between the two banks is imminent should be taken with a grain of salt," said Swedish business daily Finanstidningen.

Sources told the newspaper that the banks boards have not received any concrete merger proposal and that a merger may not take place until February 18 by which time both banks will have presented 1996 earnings results.
S-E-Banken is due to present its result on February 14 and Nordbanken, which is 59 percent state-owned, will release its annual earnings on February 18.
